parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The response language. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

parameters.name: DescSort
parameters.description: Indicates whether to sort the results in descending order.

parameters.name: FilterParams
parameters.description: The filter conditions, specified as a JSON string, such as {"key1":"value1"}.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.
